007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009/**
010 * Immutable metadata for one entry in a tool's {@code tool_inputs} array.
011 * <p>
012 * The name identifies the tool input; the optional description provides
013 * instructions to the model. Describing supported values does not enforce
014 * those values in Java. The database validates input names and their
015 * compatibility with the configured tool. This model describes an input,
016 * not the input value passed to {@code Tool.run(...)}.
017 *
018 * @see ToolAttributes
019 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolInputSample.html">
020 *      ToolInputSample source</a>
021 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateToolWithInputsSample.html">
022 *      CreateToolWithInputsSample source</a>
023 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/SetToolInputsSample.html">
024 *      SetToolInputsSample source</a>
025 * @since 1.1.0
026 */
027public final class ToolInput {
028    /** Input name understood by the configured tool. */
029    private final String name;
030    /** Optional model-facing description of the input. */
031    private final String description;
032
033    private ToolInput(Builder builder) {
034        this.name = builder.name;
035        this.description = builder.description;
036    }
037
038    /**
039     * Returns the input name without accessing the database.
040     *
041     * @return input name, or {@code null} when unset
042     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolInputSample.html">
043     *      ToolInputSample source</a>
044     */
045    public String getName() {
046        return name;
047    }
048
049    /**
050     * Returns the description supplied to the model, not a validation rule.
051     *
052     * @return input description, or {@code null} when unset
053     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolInputSample.html">
054     *      ToolInputSample source</a>
055     */
056    public String getDescription() {
057        return description;
058    }
059
060    /**
061     * Creates a builder for tool input metadata.
062     *
063     * @return mutable tool input builder
064     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolInputSample.html">
065     *      ToolInputSample source</a>
066     */
067    public static Builder builder() {
068        return new Builder();
069    }
070
071    /**
072     * Builder for {@link ToolInput}; semantic validation is delegated to the database.
073     *
074     * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolInputSample.html">
075     *      ToolInputSample source</a>
076     */
077    public static final class Builder {
078        /** Input name understood by the configured tool. */
079        private String name;
080        /** Optional model-facing description. */
081        private String description;
082
083        private Builder() {
084        }
085
086        /**
087         * Sets the input name. The database validates required names.
088         *
089         * @param name input name
090         * @return this builder
091         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolInputSample.html">
092         *      ToolInputSample source</a>
093         */
094        public Builder name(String name) {
095            this.name = name;
096            return this;
097        }
098
099        /**
100         * Sets optional instructions describing the input to the model.
101         *
102         * @param description input description, or {@code null} to omit it
103         * @return this builder
104         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolInputSample.html">
105         *      ToolInputSample source</a>
106         */
107        public Builder description(String description) {
108            this.description = description;
109            return this;
110        }
111
112        /**
113         * Builds immutable input metadata without accessing the database.
114         *
115         * @return immutable tool input metadata
116         * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/ToolInputSample.html">
117         *      ToolInputSample source</a>
118         */
119        public ToolInput build() {
120            return new ToolInput(this);
121        }
122    }
123}
